lead.headline: Three questionable starters, and the flex call comes Friday
lead.deck: Allen, Jefferson and Coker all expected to play. McLaurin locks at 07:30 Sunday, so Friday's report decides.
lead.body: Three of your starters are questionable: Josh Allen with a knee contusion, Justin Jefferson with an ankle sprain and Jalen Coker with a quad strain. Every report says all three play: Chao calls Allen 'hurt, not injured', Jefferson's MRI was clean, and Coker 'avoided serious injury'. The Gordon claim went through at 01:02 and Tuten is in Achane's old slot, so the lineup as set is 0.8 from the projection lineup. That 0.8 is the flex: Coker 13.8 against McLaurin 13.0, a coin flip the projection decides. The catch is the clock. McLaurin plays at 07:30 Sunday in London, so the flex and the Jefferson fallback have to be settled on Friday's report, not Sunday's inactives. ESPN has Aye-Aye at 125.2 against your 125.9.

roster.deck: Gap 0.8: the projection puts Coker in the flex over McLaurin, a coin flip. Allen, Jefferson and Coker are conditional.
